svg.title: Why repeated status checks consume so many tokens
svg.desc: The accumulated coding-agent context feeds four repeated CI status checks. Each status result invokes the model again and re-processes the full context. One observed sequence of four GitHub Actions status-check turns totalled about 1.184 million raw processed tokens, roughly 296K each, mostly cached input and not equivalent to fresh-token billing.
